# Code map

One row per module in `src/ws/`, and one per sub-package. Each row is the first sentence of the module's docstring, so the
docstring is the contract and this page can't drift from the code: `python3 scripts/gen_code_map.py` rewrites the table
below, and `python3 scripts/gen_code_map.py --check` (prek and CI) fails when it's stale. Edit a docstring, not the table.
